title: pg_topology_runtime_guard_v1
description: Root-owned runtime guard contract that binds the immutable scanner-read-only learning.alr_runtime_cluster_identity row to the exact runtime DB identity (§8.2). It binds that row digest, the plan/topology digest, the independently observed system_identifier / database OID / server major version, the fixed runtime endpoint (host/port/dbname property-only per §9-G, never a frozen exact unit/identity name) and a host-generated non-secret binding nonce. The guard file is rendered by the ENGINE_SCANNER host actor from signed plan fields, is group-readable mode 0440 at runtime and is included in the unit/plan/postcheck identities. self_digest is integrity evidence only.
